'''4B-EG-6''' was a [[Color|green]]-colored, [[Manumission|emancipated]] [[GNK-series power droid]] with [[Gender|masculine programming]] that diligently served the [[Resistance]] during their [[Cold War|conflict]] with the group known as the [[First Order]]. The [[Power droid|droid]] was stationed at the [[Resistance base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]], where he maintained the facility's equipment while also secretly serving as a member of the [[Resistance spy droid network]].

In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]], 4B-EG-6 was waiting in the base's landing zones when Resistance [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]]s returned victorious from the [[battle of Takodana]] and later the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]]. When the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' left D'Qar to travel to the planet [[Ahch-To]], the power [[droid]] was among a crowd of Resistance members who saw the [[starship]] off.

==Biography==
===Base power source===
The [[Manumission|emancipated]] [[GNK-series power droid]] designated 4B-EG-6<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> had [[Gender|masculine programming]]<ref name="Labor" /> and was used by the [[Resistance]] during its [[Cold War|conflict]] with the resurgent political and [[First Order military|military]] group known as the [[First Order]]. The [[Power droid|droid]] was stationed at the Resistance's [[Resistance base|base of operations]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]],<ref name="Geektionary" /> where he was one of the power droids most often assigned to the base's landing field<ref name="BuildR268" /> and was responsible for providing continuous energy to the network of [[starship]] runways,<ref name="Geektionary" /> including recharging inflight<ref name="Labor" /> and power systems aboard newly returned [[starfighter]]s.<ref name="BuildR268" /> He also diligently worked to maintain the base's equipment.<ref name="TFAVD" />

As the leaders of the Resistance intended the base to be easily dismantled, packed up and shipped out, the mobile power and maintenance provided by 4B-EG-6 was essential for ground crews and [[Resistance pilot|pilots]] who needed to maintain their starships at peak operating capacity.<ref name="BuildR2">[[Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2 6|''Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2'' 6]]</ref> He made other contributions to the Resistance that often went undetected,<ref name="Labor" /> and was classified and secretly served as a member of the [[Resistance spy droid network]] run by the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]], reporting what he saw and heard to C-3PO's subordinate [[PZ-4CO]].<ref name="AB Updated" />

===Read to serve===
[[File:Poe_dismounts_X-Wing.png|thumb|left|250px|4B-EG-6 tended to ''Black One'' after the battle of Takodana.]]
In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VII}} to [[34 ABY]].</ref> when the [[Blue Squadron (Resistance)|Blue Squadron]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> of [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]]s returned from [[Battle of Takodana|fighting]] the First Order on the planet [[Takodana]],<ref name="TFA" /> 4B-EG-6 set about recharging the squadron's fighters<ref name="Labor" /> and tended to one of their ships immediately after they landed in the D'Qar base in the landing bay opposite the [[YT-1300 light freighter]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''.<ref name="TFA" /> He was then part of the maintenance crew that serviced ''[[Black One]]'',<ref name="BuildR2" /> the [[X-wing starfighter]] of [[Black Leader]] [[Poe Dameron]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

The [[droid]] was once again present in the bay opposite the ''Falcon''{{'s}} landing zone when the Resistance's [[pilot]]s returned to D'Qar after successfully [[Battle of Starkiller Base|destroying]] the First Order's [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]]. When the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] left D'Qar aboard the ''Falcon'' in order to travel to<ref name="TFA" /> the planet [[Ahch-To]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> shortly afterwards, 4B-EG-6 was standing with fellow Resistance droid<ref name="TFA" /> [[B-U4D]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> being checked over by another member of the Resistance before both droids joined the large crowd that had gathered to wave the [[freighter]] off.<ref name="TFA" /> He then aided in the rapid dismantling of the base for evacuation when the First Order [[Battle of D'Qar|counter-attacked]] D'Qar.<ref name="Labor" />

==Characteristics==
4B-EG-6 was a devoted member of the Resistance and tried to be constantly available so that equipment was always functional,<ref name="Geektionary" /> working diligently<ref name="Labor" /> and taking only periodic maintenance breaks.<ref name="TFAVD" /> Like all GNK power droids, he stood 1.1 [[meter]]s tall<ref name="DB" /> with a stocky appearance and bulky angular body<ref name="Labor" /> manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="CEUE" /> He was built with a pair of [[Limb|legs]] so that he could walk to where he was needed and provide power with his internal [[fusion generator]].<ref name="TFAVD" /> He was [[Color|green]] in color with red markings on his front panel and a yellow strip on his rear panel.<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Fan_Droids_explosion.png|thumb|right|250px|4B-EG-6 becomes extremely excited after seeing R2-D2 in "Fan Droids."]]
4B-EG-6 first appeared in the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. The droid was not identified in the film,<ref name="TFA" /> but his name was revealed in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> and released in conjunction with Episode VII.<ref name="New Books">{{SW|url=news/a-galaxy-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens-books-coming-december-18-first-look|text=A Galaxy of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Books Coming December 18 - UPDATED!}}</ref>

===Non-canon content===
In the ''[[Star Wars Blips]]'' non-[[canon]] animated short "[[Fan Droids]],"<ref name="Blips">{{Blips|Fan Droids}}</ref> released on [[September 3]], [[2017]],<ref name="YouTube">{{SWYouTube|series=Star Wars Blips|text=Fan Droids|video=osXqwvaUCsc}} {{C|[[:File:Fan_Droids_release_date.png|screenshot]]}}</ref> 4B-EG-6 and several other Droids of the Resistance are shown watching a [[Hologram|holographic]] projection showing the past exploits of the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]]. They then become extremely excited when R2-D2 himself passes them, with the GNK droid becoming so excited that part of its front panel explodes, causing it to fall onto its back.<ref name="Blips" />

4B-EG-6 also appears in the first three episodes of ''[[Star Wars Roll Out]]'', a non-canon series of animated shorts released in [[2019]].<ref name="Roll Out">''[[Star Wars Roll Out]]'' - ''[[BB-8 and the Jungle Adventure - Chapter 1]]''</ref><ref name="Roll Out 2">{{RollOut|BB-8 and the Jungle Adventure - Chapter 2}}</ref><ref name="Roll Out 3">{{RollOut|BB-8 and the Jungle Adventure - Chapter 3}}</ref> 4B-EG-6 is part of a group of Droids of the Resistance who are working in the jungle near the D'Qar Resistance base. BB-8 comes across the group before getting trapped in a [[Plant|vine]] hanging from one of the jungle [[tree]]s. The group try to aid BB-8, but accidentally launch him into the sky, causing them to panic.<ref name="Roll Out" />

[[File:Roll_Out_Cast.png|thumb|left|250px|4B-EG-6 aided in rescuing BB-8 from the D'Qar jungle.]]
Using a [[Hologram|holographic]] map, the droids located where BB-8 had landed and began rushing through the jungle to reach him. They stopped upon hearing the roars of various jungle creatures, at which point a small creature lowered itself down on webbing next to 4B-EG-6. Upon seeing the creature, the power droid and his companions cried out in terror and fled. When they stopped again to check the map, 4B-EG-6 did not stop quickly enough and ran into the back of one of the other droids.<ref name="Roll Out 2" />

4B-EG-6 and its companions found BB-8 as he and two native [[Changeling|shapeshifting]] animals had just finished using [[Plant|vines]] to tie up a large [[spider]]-like creature that had attacked them. The droids were initially confused by the fact that the two shapeshifters were identical to BB-8, but then aided them in weighing down the spider-like creature before releasing it and launching it into the air with the vines. With the creature defeated, the droids all came together and celebrated until the two shapeshifters reverted to their natural forms, causing 4B-EG-6 and its companions to flee.<ref name="Roll Out 3" />
